The Office of Admissions
International Admissions
Graduate
Graduate Admission Requirements
All international graduate applicants must:
Have an earned baccalaureate degree from an accredited college or university (You must complete the degree prior to enrollment at BGSU.)
Provide English language proficiency test scores
Minimum test scores are:
2025 and before: TOEFL IBT: 80 (old scale) [We do not accept the TOEFL MyBest Score.] 2026 and beyond: TOEFL IBT: 4 (new scale)
IELTS: 6.5
PTE (Pearson Test of English): 53
Duolingo: 110
Completion of ELS Intensive English for Academic Purposes Level 112
You don’t need to provide English proficiency test scores if you:
Are a U.S. citizen or
Have a previous degree (associate’s, bachelor’s, master’s or doctorate) from a U.S. college/university or
Are from, or earned a degree from, a country in which instruction was delivered in English
Additional application requirements vary by program.

Documents to submit when you apply
All documents are submitted through the BGSU online application.
Scanned copies of official or unofficial transcripts from all institutions you have attended. Upon admission, you will need to submit final official or notarized copies of transcripts from all institutions where you earned degrees (showing dates when the degrees were conferred) and diplomas from international institutions.
Standardized test scores (GRE, GMAT, PRAXIS, OAE) may be required. Check with your academic program.
Programs may also require recommendations, a statement of purpose, a resume and other documents. Check with your academic program.
Important note about documents
If admitted, all documents must be official and in the English language. We cannot accept photocopies or documents marked "Issued to Student."
To qualify as an official document, your document must be ONE of the following:
Original document
Notarized or attested copy
Official English translation with the official seal or stamp of the notary or the English translator on each document
All credentials submitted to BGSU become the property of BGSU and will not be released.
How to apply to BGSU
Qualifying countries include Anguilla; Antigua and Barbuda; Australia; Bahamas; Barbados; Belize; Bermuda; Botswana; British Guyana; Canada (except Quebec); Cayman Islands; Dominica; Eritrea; Falkland Islands (Islas Malvinas); Fiji; Gambia (The); Ghana; Grenada; Guam; Guyana; Ireland; Jamaica; Kenya; Lesotho; Liberia; Malawi; Montserrat; New Zealand; Nigeria; Sierra Leone; Singapore; St. Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha; St. Kitts and Nevis; St. Lucia; St. Vincent and the Grenadine; South Africa; Swaziland; Tanzania; Trinidad and Tobago; Turks and Caicos Isle; Uganda; United Kingdom; Virgin Islands; Zambia; and Zimbabwe.
